reason: The neutral and coding descriptions specify recall of associated backgrounds for emotional versus neutral items in Experiment 2 with partial eta-squared on p. 8 (printed p. 967), which cannot uniquely select a single target test: the tests reporting partial eta-squared (h2p) are the unconditioned Valence main effect across both object and background targets (F(2,52) = 4.66, h2p = .152), the unconditioned TargetxValence interaction testing differential directionality across target types (F(2,52) = 3.95, h2p = .132), and the conditionalized-for-recognition Valence main effect across both targets (F(2,52) = 6.50, h2p = .200, where the interaction is non-significant), whereas the contrasts specifically testing background recall for emotional versus neutral object cues are split into separate positive-versus-neutral (t(26) = 3.65) and negative-versus-neutral (t(26) = 3.22) t-tests without a printed partial eta-squared. Because neither nonnumeric metadata nor source structure selects a unique single-statistic target, a general replication narrative or shared significance across candidate tests cannot certify effect-specific reported_success for this row.
